root_cause.text: In the `p2pmem_alloc_mmap` function of the PCI/P2PDMA subsystem, the error handling path triggered by a failed `vm_insert_page()` call neglects to invoke `percpu_ref_put()` to release the acquired pgmap reference, resulting in a reference count leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the addition of `percpu_ref_put(ref);` within the `if (ret)` error block in `drivers/pci/p2pdma.c`, which addresses the CVE description stating that omitting this call causes `memunmap_pages()` to hang indefinitely during PCI device removal.
